The search states no total; rows for the same university, faculty or institute, programme, level, city and language that appeared more than once were merged (30 repeats). Spot checks of three universities against the search's university filter gave the same counts as the page-by-page read.

The last rows of each of the bachelor's, master's and doctorate lists are the Art Scholarship Program departments named on the programmes page (8 bachelor's, 7 master's, 1 PhD, at Ankara Music and Fine Arts University, Ankara Haci Bayram Veli University and Istanbul Technical University); many of them also appear as ordinary programme rows.

Programme names are copied as the search shows them, including a language tag in brackets such as (English) where the source gives one; the language of instruction is in each row's detail (Turkish, English, English (%30) and others as written in the search).

The Merit Scholarship is a double-stipend category open to applicants of the ordinary programmes who meet the score criteria; it has no separate programme list. The Scholarship Procedures Guide has no department list.

Associate-degree (technical and vocational) programmes are few in the search (57 entries before merging). Master's entries carry two spellings of the level name (Master's Degree and master's Degree); both were treated as master's.
